generateTriageIntelligenceForIssues.temperatureReason: Conditional dependency of successful issue creation/update (including the paged update handler).
generateTriageIntelligenceForIssues.reason: Partially owned, still pending: bounded mode (generateTriageIntelligenceForIssuesBounded) reproduces the background-run starts and heuristic generation, including auto-applied project/label/relation suggestions and batches, exactly through mutateBoundedIssueSuggestions with complete scoring inputs (TestScaleP21TriageGenerateWriterDifferential). Two inputs are refused before any write: workspaces whose team suggestions may auto-move issues (the bounded writer does not renumber), and batches in which one scoped issue is another's candidate, where the legacy callback writes the candidate summary over the full scoped issue row (the test observes the stored row shrinking to the summary). Both keep this consumer blocked.

listIssueSuggestions.temperatureReason: Issue-detail triage suggestion component fetches/polls this endpoint.
listIssueSuggestions.reason: Off mode keeps the literal handler. Bounded mode delegates to listIssueSuggestionsBounded: the absent-actor fallback uses the proven BeginInstalledViewerRead (contextless, like legacy WorkspaceMetadata); the paged projection's only used outputs (its error, team rows and project filter, then mcpWorkspaceData's selected-team credential filter) come from ViewerProjectionScope/ProjectVisibleInProjection; the issue's suggestions come from ReadIssueSuggestions; core workspace, workspaceSettings and one teamSettings point come from one installed generation. Issue query, AuthorizedIssueRecord, refreshTriageIntelligence and run tracking calls are unchanged. TestScaleP21TriageListSuggestionsDifferential compares exact status and body bytes of legacy, warm and SQL-reloaded bounded views over 236 cases (admin, private outsider, member, guest with grant, sub-team inheritance x session/unrestricted/selected-empty/selected-set keys, agent on/off, ID/identifier/private/missing issues, default/missing/foreign bindings, absent actor, cancelled requests) with visible, private, child, mixed, unscoped, archived and missing project/team/issue targets and inactive/other-issue/duplicate rows, and zero full metadata decodes. Background runs started by refreshTriageIntelligence remain covered by runTriageIntelligence, which is still pending.

previewIssueSuggestions.temperatureReason: Issue-create suggestion preview endpoint; conservative HOT for the ordinary issue-creation flow.

pruneIssueSuggestionTargets.temperatureReason: Callers are issue/project deletion and user/label deactivation/purge; no issue create/update/comment/reaction caller was found.
pruneIssueSuggestionTargets.reason: Off mode keeps the literal WorkspaceMetadata scan. Bounded mode finds stale issues with VisitIssueSuggestions over one installed generation (one decoded row at a time, contextless like WorkspaceMetadata) and runs the unchanged batched callback through mutateBoundedIssueSuggestions under an independent output owner. TestScaleP21TriagePruneWriterDifferential compares legacy, warm and SQL-reloaded bounded runs for multi-issue project, assignee, label/team, dismissed-only, empty and missing-workspace predicates: issue rows (version, order, data), activity/content rows, the complete issueSuggestions list in canonical order, project rows, domain events, webhook and realtime envelopes, normalizing only generated stamps and call clocks, with zero full decodes. A concurrent stale row added for an issue outside the scanned batch is left for the next prune, where the legacy full callback would also delete it.

refreshIssueSuggestions.reason: Direct read only: absent request actor uses an owned BeginInstalledViewerRead snapshot of exact installed core Viewer, held through the run service and response. Off mode retains the literal WorkspaceMetadata branch; supplied actors/API keys and run ordering are unchanged. The adaptive clone has an independent work allowance, preserves NUL/nil/empty fields and legacy Via omission, and keeps exact default/missing/NUL Go workspace lookup. SW20 triage differentials cover full principal/key matrix, actual Viewer delta plus full UpdateWorkspace warm/canonical divergence, actor-ID authorization outcome, default/missing/foreign bindings and legacy canceled handler output, with zero full decodes. runTriageIntelligence remains independently pending for complete heuristic inputs and mutations; this review certifies the direct fallback source, not successful endpoint readiness.

updateIssueSuggestionState.temperatureReason: Acceptance/dismissal route updates an issue from its detail suggestion UI.
updateIssueSuggestionState.reason: Partially owned, still pending: bounded mode (updateIssueSuggestionStateBounded) reproduces dismissals and non-team acceptances exactly through mutateBoundedIssueSuggestions (TestScaleP21TriageSuggestionStateWriterDifferential, 18 cases x3 sources). Accepting a team suggestion moves and renumbers the issue; the bounded writer refuses it with ErrIssueSuggestionWriteRefused (no write, no publication), so team acceptance keeps this consumer blocked until a bounded team-move writer exists.
